partes.texto: The Rune Page that is currently considered the strongest combination and can be used into almost every matchup. Grasp/Aftershock are interchangeable depending on matchup and preference.
Recommended Runes

Grasp > Aftershock
Demolish + Second Wind + Overgrowth
Secondary Rune Path(s)

Biscuit Delivery + 
Cosmic Insight/Approach Velocity

(optional) Sudden Impact + Ultimate Hunter
or Legend: Haste + Last Stand/Triumph/PoM
Possible Major Adjustments
Inspiration

Inspiration is a super safe learning setup due to Biscuit Delivery, but also works as a preference choice. Always take Cosmic Insight as it is the most impactful option. Due to the safety/consistency, the sheet mainly recommends it as a second rune path, but it isn't a requirement.
Other Inspiration combinations:
Magical Footwear + Cosmic Insight - Mobility/Econ option
Biscuit Delivery + Cosmic Insight - Safe option into lane bullies
Domination
Sudden Impact + Ultimate Hunter
Focused around aggressive and easy trades with Sudden Impact. Best paired with Grasp + Shield Bash setups to maximize short Q+AA trade patterns
Precision
Legend:Haste and Last Stand are the best options to take. No reason to take anything else.
Possible Minor Adjustments
Shield Bash > Demolish: Shield Bash can be used if you don't expect to get a lot of value out of Demolish (Turret Plates)
Revitalize/Overgrowth/Unfliching: Revitalize adds more value if your team has a lot of healing and shielding. Unflinching adds trading power early in matchups that proc it.

Minor Rune Shards
Scaling Health > 15% Tenacity and Slow Resistance: The Tenacity and Slow Resistance can be very impactful into Slow and CC heavy comps, but isn't necessary if the enemy comp barely has any CC.
Starting Items
Doran's Helm + Health Potion (x1)
Dorans helm is incredibly important, never take D-Shield, if you are against a big lane bully then take second wind + biscuits, the resistances are too valuable to pass up.
Core Build

This core build is the most reliable build for Iron - Master lobbies, if you were to default to a single build, this would be it. Against an AD opponent, prioritize 2x chain vests then finish your items, Knights vow third is good when you have a very fed teammate, adapt as you see fit in your game. Against an AP opponent, Kaenic first is most recommended, followed by gauntlet. Frozen heart can be slotted in over gauntlet as well.
Other Items to look out for:
Items to avoid
K'Sante does not need the wave clear, as well as low resists

Any item that gives Attack damage = not optimal

 (K'Sante has no AD or AP scalings)
